name: Investor portals and fund administration
what: Where sponsors onboard investors, collect subscriptions, run capital calls and distributions, and post reports.

tasks.title: Create an investor and send subscription documents
tasks.question: Can an agent create an investor record and send subscription documents through the API?
tasks.full: API documentation shows how to create investors and how to send or start subscription documents.
tasks.partial: Only one of the two through the API, or either one only through a third-party integration.

tasks.title: Post a distribution and notify investors
tasks.question: Can an agent post a distribution and generate the investor notices through the API?
tasks.full: API documentation shows how to create distributions and how to generate or send the notices.
tasks.partial: Distributions can be read but not created through the API, or notices need a person in the app.

tasks.title: Pull the investor register
tasks.question: Can an agent pull the investor register (investors, commitments and contributions) as structured data?
tasks.full: API endpoints or a documented export return investors, commitments and contributions as JSON or CSV.
tasks.partial: Only part of the register, or only through a manual export in the app.

tasks.title: Issue a capital call and track funding
tasks.question: Can an agent issue a capital call and track which investors have funded, through the API?
tasks.full: API documentation shows how to create capital calls and read each investor's funding status.
tasks.partial: Funding status can be read but calls cannot be created through the API, or the reverse.
